rendered: Export Note sheet: the picked format row gets a brand-red outline and a filled red ring with a tick
why: 'Picked' is not a meaning in the key, and the selection doctrine (DS:206-215) says a picked control inverts to --sel-bg and never goes red. Here brand red marks a selection, not a tap. The row is a button, so red is not strictly forbidden, which is why confidence is low.
fix: .exp-format.on { border-color: var(--tint); }  ->  .exp-format.on { border-color: var(--sel-bg); }   .exp-format.on .exp-ring { border-color: var(--tint); background: var(--tint); }  ->  .exp-format.on .exp-ring { border-color: var(--sel-bg); background: var(--sel-bg); }   .exp-format.on .exp-ring::after { ... border: solid #fff; ... }  ->  .exp-format.on .exp-ring::after { ... border: solid var(--sel-fg); ... }
